items.name: Oxford Street
items.description: London's busiest shopping street for department stores, global brands, trainers, beauty, and quick central browsing.
items.highlights: Nike, H&M, Zara, Primark, Selfridges, John Lewis, Marks & Spencer, ASOS, Topshop building

subShops.name: Selfridges
subShops.note: London's most iconic department store — 5 floors of luxury fashion, beauty, tech and food.

subShops.name: Primark
subShops.note: Europe's biggest Primark — massive 5-floor store with fashion, beauty and homeware at unbeatable prices.

subShops.name: H&M
subShops.note: Affordable everyday fashion for women, men and kids across multiple floors.

subShops.name: Zara
subShops.note: On-trend fashion and accessories across 3 floors of the flagship Oxford Street store.

subShops.name: Nike Town
subShops.note: Massive flagship store with the latest Nike trainers, sportswear and exclusive drops.

subShops.name: John Lewis
subShops.note: Classic British department store — tech, home, fashion and beauty all in one place.

items.name: Carnaby Street
items.description: Colourful pedestrian streets with independent labels, sneaker shops, restaurants, and easy access to Liberty.

subShops.name: Levi's
subShops.note: The original denim brand — jeans, jackets and streetwear. Classic and modern fits.

subShops.name: Vans
subShops.note: Iconic skate brand with shoes, clothing and accessories. Exclusives you won't find elsewhere.

subShops.name: Dr. Martens
subShops.note: The original Carnaby boots — classic 1460s, Chelsea boots and seasonal collaborations.

subShops.name: Liberty London
subShops.note: Just steps away — iconic Tudor building with luxury fashion, beauty and the famous Liberty print fabrics.

items.name: King's Road
items.description: Chelsea shopping with fashion boutiques, interior design stores, cafes, and a polished west London pace.

subShops.name: Anthropologie
subShops.note: Beautiful bohemian fashion, homeware and gifts. One of the most gorgeous shops on King's Road.

subShops.name: Peter Jones
subShops.note: A Chelsea institution and John Lewis partner — fashion, home, beauty and tech.

subShops.name: Vivienne Westwood
subShops.note: The original punk-turned-luxury British designer. Bold, iconic and uniquely British.

subShops.name: Space NK
subShops.note: Premium beauty and skincare — Nars, Charlotte Tilbury, By Terry and more cult brands.

items.name: Westfield Stratford City
items.description: Large indoor mall with fashion, tech, food courts, cinema, and direct links to the Elizabeth line and Central line.

subShops.name: John Lewis
subShops.note: Flagship Westfield store — tech, fashion, home and beauty all under one roof.

subShops.name: Zara
subShops.note: On-trend fashion for women, men and kids. Multiple floors in the Westfield location.

subShops.name: Apple Store
subShops.note: Full Apple product range — iPhone, Mac, iPad and accessories with Genius Bar support.

subShops.name: Nike
subShops.note: Latest Nike trainers and sportswear. Great for limited edition drops.

subShops.name: Adidas
subShops.note: Flagship Adidas store — trainers, sportswear, Originals and exclusive collab pieces.

items.name: Canary Wharf
items.description: Sleek malls, restaurants, waterside walks, and public art beneath the financial district's towers.

subShops.name: Marks & Spencer
subShops.note: Great M&S food hall for lunch plus classic British clothing and homeware.

subShops.name: Reiss
subShops.note: Contemporary British fashion — sharp workwear, occasion wear and weekend casual.

subShops.name: Hugo Boss
subShops.note: German premium fashion — tailored suits, smart casual and sportswear.

subShops.name: Sweaty Betty
subShops.note: Premium British activewear for women — yoga, running and gym wear that actually looks good.

items.name: Covent Garden
items.description: Beauty brands, boutiques, Apple Market crafts, street performers, and excellent pre-theatre browsing.

subShops.name: Apple Store
subShops.note: Stunning Apple flagship store inside the historic market building. Full range with Genius Bar.

subShops.name: Mulberry
subShops.note: British luxury leather bags and accessories. Somerset and Bayswater bags are iconic.

subShops.name: Lush
subShops.note: Handmade cosmetics, bath bombs, shampoo bars and fresh skincare in the flagship Covent Garden store.

subShops.name: Jo Malone
subShops.note: Classic British perfume house — colognes, candles and bath products in stunning packaging.

subShops.name: Fossil
subShops.note: Stylish watches, leather bags and accessories at accessible luxury prices.

items.name: Portobello Road Area
items.description: Pastel streets, antique dealers, vintage clothing, cafes, and one of London's most photogenic market walks.

subShops.name: Antique Stalls
subShops.note: Hundreds of stalls selling silverware, vintage jewellery, ceramics and rare collectibles.

subShops.name: Vintage Clothing Stalls
subShops.note: Amazing selection of vintage and retro clothing — 1950s to 1990s fashion.

subShops.name: Books for Cooks
subShops.note: Legendary cookbook shop with a tiny test kitchen inside where recipes are cooked daily.

subShops.name: The Spice Shop
subShops.note: Incredible selection of global spices, teas, herbs and exotic ingredients from around the world.

items.name: Borough Market
items.description: Historic food market for artisan produce, prepared dishes, baked goods, spices, coffee, and edible gifts.

subShops.name: Neal's Yard Dairy
subShops.note: The best British and Irish artisan cheeses — friendly staff who let you taste before you buy.

subShops.name: Monmouth Coffee
subShops.note: London's best coffee. Queue is always worth it — iconic Borough Market institution since 1978.

subShops.name: The Flour Station
subShops.note: Incredible sourdough and artisan breads baked fresh daily — sellout by midday on weekends.

subShops.name: Turnips
subShops.note: Best fruit, vegetables and herbs from award-winning Borough Market traders.

items.name: Portobello Road Market
items.openingHours: Monday-Saturday; Saturday is main antiques day
items.description: Antiques, vintage clothes, bric-a-brac, produce, and colourful Notting Hill streets in one long market route.

items.name: Columbia Road Flower Market
items.description: Plants, flowers, independent shops, and loud market banter. Go early for space or late for bargains.

items.name: Camden Market
items.description: A sprawling mix of food stalls, music culture, vintage, souvenirs, canalside views, and bold street style.

subShops.name: Stables Market
subShops.note: Huge market in Victorian horse stables — vintage clothing, tattoos, alternative fashion and street food.

subShops.name: Camden Lock Market
subShops.note: Artisan food traders, handmade crafts and unique gifts right by the canal.

subShops.name: Psychedelic Vintage
subShops.note: Incredible vintage clothing and retro pieces from every era — great for unique finds.

subShops.name: Electric Market
subShops.note: Band tees, vinyl records, punk fashion and music memorabilia across multiple stalls.

items.name: Greenwich Market
items.description: Covered market with crafts, jewellery, street food, and easy access to the Cutty Sark and park.

subShops.name: Antique Stalls
subShops.note: Weekend antique market with jewellery, silverware, vintage maps and maritime collectibles.

subShops.name: Artisan Food Stalls
subShops.note: Amazing rotating food stalls — Ethiopian, Venezuelan, Vietnamese, Indian and more.

subShops.name: Craft & Handmade Stalls
subShops.note: Local artists selling handmade jewellery, ceramics, prints and gifts.

items.name: Old Spitalfields Market
items.description: Covered market with independent designers, food traders, vintage days, and walks to Brick Lane.

subShops.name: Independent Designer Stalls
subShops.note: New London designers selling unique clothing, prints and accessories — find something truly one-of-a-kind.

subShops.name: Street Food Traders
subShops.note: Rotating international street food stalls — Japanese, Ethiopian, Lebanese, Indian and more.

subShops.name: Tatty Devine
subShops.note: Fun, colourful acrylic jewellery handmade in London. Perfect for unique gifts.

subShops.name: Vintage & Art Stalls
subShops.note: Second-hand books, handmade art, ceramics and gifts from local artists every week.

items.name: Brick Lane Market
items.description: Vintage clothing, records, street food, curry houses, murals, and East London weekend energy.

subShops.name: Vintage Clothing Warehouse
subShops.note: Massive indoor warehouse full of vintage clothing by weight — one of the best in London.

subShops.name: Street Food Stalls
subShops.note: London's most diverse food market — Bengali curries, salt beef bagels, Ethiopian and more.

subShops.name: Vintage Record Stalls
subShops.note: Vinyl records, cassettes and music memorabilia for collectors and music lovers.

items.name: Bermondsey Antiques Market
items.description: Early-bird antiques market for jewellery, silver, prints, collectables, and dealers who know their stock.

items.name: Leather Lane Market
items.description: A practical local lunch market for office workers, with street food, coffee, and bargain stalls.

items.name: London Transport Museum Shop
items.openingHours: Daily; hours follow museum shop schedule
items.description: Beautiful Tube posters, moquette gifts, maps, toys, books, and well-made London transport souvenirs.

items.name: Fortnum & Mason
items.description: Tea, biscuits, hampers, preserves, and polished British gifts in an iconic department store.

subShops.name: Tea Room & Café
subShops.note: World-famous afternoon tea — quintessentially British. Book in advance.

subShops.name: Food Hall
subShops.note: Exquisite hampers, biscuits, preserves, teas, chocolates and luxury groceries.

subShops.name: Chocolate & Confectionery
subShops.note: Handmade chocolates, truffles and luxury sweets in beautiful Fortnum's gift boxes.

items.name: Liberty London
items.description: Timber-framed department store with signature prints, scarves, beauty, homeware, and memorable gifts.

subShops.name: Liberty Print Fabrics
subShops.note: The most famous fabrics in Britain — iconic Liberty floral prints sold by the metre.

subShops.name: Beauty Hall
subShops.note: Carefully curated luxury beauty — Aesop, Diptyque, By Terry and many cult brands.

subShops.name: Designer Fashion Floor
subShops.note: Curated international designers — pieces you won't find in regular department stores.

subShops.name: Gifts & Homeware
subShops.note: Unique gifts, ceramics, candles and homeware — perfect for something special.

items.name: Royal Collection Shop
items.description: Official royal china, books, ornaments, decorations, and tasteful palace-themed keepsakes.

items.name: Harrods
items.description: A landmark department store for food halls, teddy bears, fragrance, designer goods, and premium London gifts.

subShops.name: Chanel
subShops.note: The iconic French luxury fashion and beauty house. Bags, perfume and ready-to-wear.

subShops.name: Louis Vuitton
subShops.note: Designer handbags, luggage, shoes and accessories from the world's most iconic luxury house.

subShops.name: Gucci
subShops.note: Italian luxury fashion — iconic bags, shoes, and ready-to-wear from the Florence house.

subShops.name: Harrods Food Hall
subShops.note: World-famous luxury food hall — caviar, sushi, fresh pastries, cheese and incredible chocolate.

subShops.name: Dior
subShops.note: French haute couture — elegant fashion, fine jewellery and world-famous fragrances.

items.name: British Museum Shop
items.description: Books, prints, jewellery, replicas, children's gifts, and design objects inspired by the museum collection.

items.name: Portobello Road — 10% OFF
items.description: 10% off at participating antique and vintage stalls on Portobello Road. Show TAP LONDON souvenir at checkout.

items.name: Fortnum & Mason — Free Gift Wrapping
items.description: Free premium gift wrapping on any purchase at Fortnum & Mason. Show your TAP LONDON NFC souvenir at checkout.

items.name: Camden Market — 15% OFF
items.description: Exclusive 15% discount at participating stalls in Camden Market. Look for the TAP LONDON sticker at the stall.

items.name: Coal Drops Yard
items.description: A Victorian railway facility reimagined by Heatherwick Studio into one of London's best shopping destinations — independent boutiques, restaurants and bars.

items.name: Goodhood Store
items.description: A stalwart of Shoreditch's retail scene since 2007, now a 5,500 sq ft space by Spitalfields Market — streetwear, homeware and beauty with a sense of humour.

items.name: Broadway Market
items.description: A Hackney institution with an eclectic mix of vintage treasures, local crafts, souvenirs and street food along a historic tradesman's route.

items.name: Exmouth Market
items.description: A charming pedestrianised street packed with independent cafes, restaurants, bars and local craft shops — genuinely local, rarely touristy.

items.name: Victoria Park Market
items.description: A relaxed local market with street food, groceries and quirky stalls — genuinely community-focused rather than touristy.

items.name: Portobello Green Market
items.openingHours: Fri best for vintage, Sat-Sun general
items.description: The fashion-focused stretch of Portobello Road under the Westway — vintage clothing and one-off pieces from local designers, best on Fridays.

items.name: Wilton Way Shops
items.description: A charming, low-key East London street packed with independent boutiques and cafes — genuinely local character with none of the crowds.

items.name: Beyond Retro
items.location: Dalston, E8 (also Kings Cross, Soho, Westfield)
items.description: One of London's biggest vintage clothing chains, with its own upcycled fashion label — huge selection of leather coats, boots and psychedelic shirts.

items.name: Rokit Vintage
items.location: Camden, NW1 (also Brick Lane, Covent Garden)
items.description: An iconic London vintage institution across multiple locations — decades of curated finds from workwear to designer pieces.

items.name: Atika London
items.description: London's biggest vintage store in a refurbished former furniture factory — a genuinely essential stop on any vintage shopping trip.

items.name: Paper Dress Vintage
items.description: A stylish boutique that doubles as a bar and live music/exhibition venue — shop for vintage while catching a gig.

items.name: Loop Generation
items.description: Pre-loved designer consignment in Chelsea — vintage Chanel, used Hermès and high-end fashion at accessible prices.

items.name: Reign Vintage
items.description: Two airy floors of well-curated womenswear and menswear on Soho's famous Berwick Street — perfect for a quick vintage fix on your lunch hour.

items.name: Bond Street
items.description: London's premier luxury shopping street, home to flagship stores for the world's biggest fashion houses, jewellers and art galleries. Split into Old and New Bond Street.
items.highlights: Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Tiffany & Co, Cartier, Asprey, Sotheby's

items.name: Regent Street
items.description: An elegant curved boulevard connecting Oxford Circus to Piccadilly, home to Liberty department store and a more upmarket alternative to nearby Oxford Street.
items.highlights: Liberty London, Hamleys, Apple Store, Burberry

items.name: Savile Row
items.description: The world's most famous street for bespoke tailoring, home to heritage tailors who've dressed celebrities and royalty for decades. Some shops are by appointment only.
items.highlights: Henry Poole & Co, Gieves & Hawkes, Huntsman

items.name: Jermyn Street
items.description: A refined street of heritage British shirtmakers, shoemakers and grooming shops, just off Piccadilly. A go-to for classic English menswear.

items.name: Portobello Road Market
items.description: London's most famous antiques market, stretching over a mile through Notting Hill with vintage clothing, records, jewellery and street food alongside the antiques stalls.
items.highlights: Antiques, vintage fashion, vinyl records, street food

items.name: St Christopher's Place
items.description: A charming pedestrianised courtyard just off Oxford Street, packed with independent boutiques, cafés and restaurants — a quieter escape from the main shopping crowds.

items.name: Seven Dials
items.description: A distinctive seven-street junction in Covent Garden known for independent fashion boutiques, concept stores and a lively food scene radiating out from the central sundial monument.

items.name: Daunt Books
items.description: A stunning Edwardian bookshop with long oak galleries and skylights, famous for organising books by country rather than genre. A beautiful spot for travel writing and fiction alike.

items.name: Dover Street Market
items.description: A boundary-pushing concept store spanning six floors, curated by Comme des Garçons' Rei Kawakubo, mixing high fashion with rotating art installations.
items.highlights: Avant-garde fashion, art installations, rotating exhibits

items.name: Seven Dials Market
items.description: KERB's food hall in Seven Dials brings independent kitchens, bars and dessert traders together in a former banana warehouse. Open until 23:00 Wednesday to Saturday; individual traders may vary.

items.name: Mercato Metropolitano Elephant & Castle
items.description: A large community food market with independent kitchens, bars and indoor and outdoor seating. Open until 23:00 or later Monday to Saturday; traders may keep different hours.

items.name: Mercato Mayfair
items.type: Food hall in a former church
items.location: St Mark's Church, North Audley Street, W1K 6ZA
items.description: International food traders and bars across three floors of St Mark's Church in Mayfair. The venue stays open until 23:00 or midnight Monday to Saturday; trader hours may vary.

items.name: Mercato Metropolitano Wood Wharf
items.description: A riverside food market with independent international kitchens, indoor seating and outdoor spaces. Open until 23:00 or midnight every day; individual trader hours may vary.

items.name: Market Halls Victoria
items.description: An Edwardian food hall with independent kitchens, bars and a rooftop terrace near Victoria station. The venue closes at 23:00 Wednesday to Saturday; kitchens close earlier.
